thread:
maria (oncall): Hitting a customer escalation — steady 504s for their hosted endpoint, looks like requests are queuing and scale-up never finishes. Ticket #C-12345. Anyone on this? :rotating_light:

autoscale-bot: ALERT: Endpoint /v1/generate - 60% 5xx over 5m, queue depth 1200, average scaleup time 90s. Related scaledobject: svc-tenant-42.

alan (support): Customer says timeouts start ~10:12am UTC, they see partial tokens then connection drops. Passed logs and a heap of client retries. Severity P1.

devin (eng-sre): On it. Can you paste the pod / scaledobject status? quick commands that help: `kubectl get hpa -n infra` and `kubectl describe scaledobject svc-tenant-42 -n hosted`

maria (oncall): From the node that reported it: `kubectl get pods -n hosted | grep svc-tenant-42` shows pods Pending for 45s then CrashLoopBackOff for the init container. ScaledObject shows replicas=0 -> desired=10 but scaler didn't trigger.

raj (eng-runtime): Hmm. Common pattern: KEDA metric server flapping or annotation TTL too long so the scaler ignores bursts. Can you paste the scaledobject YAML?

alan (support): Pasted (redacted): `triggers: - type: external - metadata: queueLength: "100" cooldownPeriod: "180"` customer traffic spiky.

devin (eng-sre): That `cooldownPeriod: "180"` is high for a bursty tenant. Also seeing `minReplicaCount: 0` — means coldstart required. Scaler backs off until metrics stable, queue grows -> gateway 504s.

maria (oncall): Also see readiness probe failing for init warmup job: `warming image layers timed out` repeated 3x. So pods start slowly (images + model download), readiness false, HPA/KEDA thinks scaling not necessary because external metric never reported. Race between provision and metric emission.

raj (eng-runtime): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) manually scale deployment to 4 replicas to drain queue; 2) lower KEDA cooldown to 30s for this ScaledObject; 3) add a prewarm job for large tenants. I can push a hotfix to template for tenants > 1000 qps.

devin (eng-sre): I'll do (1) now: `kubectl scale deployment svc-tenant-42 --replicas=4 -n hosted` — done. Queue depth dropping, 504 rate falling.

maria (oncall): Customer confirms partial recovery, 504s reduced to <5%. Thanks.

devin (eng-sre): Now doing (2) - patching ScaledObject cooldown: `kubectl patch scaledobject svc-tenant-42 -n hosted --type=json -p '[[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/triggers/0/metadata/cooldownPeriod","value":"30"}]]'`

raj (eng-runtime): Also found a bug: scaledobject annotation `keda.sh/scaleDownDelay` accidentally set to `900` in onboarding template for this tenant — that's the TTL misconfig. Will open PR to change default to `60` and add unit tests.

alan (support): Noting customer refund/billing: they were hit by retries. Filing billing touch with finance. Ticket C-12345 assigned to me for follow-up.

maria (oncall): Follow-ups: raj owns PR to change template + tests, devin to verify patch across similar scaledobjects, alan to handle customer comms and credits, I'll write postmortem. ETA for postmortem draft EOW.

raj (eng-runtime): Quick repro steps for root cause: 1) Create ScaledObject with `minReplicaCount: 0` and `cooldownPeriod: 180` + large model download on start. 2) Send a sudden spike to push queue > trigger threshold. 3) Observe scaler delay and pending pods due to long init. I'll add a repro gist in the incident ticket.

devin (eng-sre): Agreed root cause = coldstart + KEDA cooldown + onboarding template misconfig. Remediation plan: emergency patch rolled, template PR, add prewarm for high-qps tenants, and add alert to detect long-running init containers ( > 30s ) for hosted pool.

maria (oncall): Closing the immediate P1. Will keep thread open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

alan (support): Customer updated, they're appreciative of the quick response. Will escalate billing separately. :thumbsup:

devin (eng-sre): Logging follow-up items in Jira: INF-4123 (PR + tests), INF-4124 (prewarm job), INF-4125 (init-probe alert).

raj (eng-runtime): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/498 - changes default scaleDownDelay -> 60s.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. I'll post the postmortem draft here when ready.
summary: P1: Customer 504s caused by queued requests + delayed scale-up due to KEDA cooldown and long pod init (coldstart). Emergency manual scale + patch applied; template PR opened; follow-ups for prewarm and alerts.
